title: Character from restricted frequency
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube $\bbr_2^n$, and let a binary subspace split identify that cube linearly with $H$ times a complementary binary cube. If $\eta$ belongs to the perpendicular subspace of $H$, then the character associated to the frequency obtained by restricting $\eta$ to the complementary factor is the sign encoding of the dot product of $\eta$ with the point $z$, for every $z$ in the original cube.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the binary cube of dimension $n$
A vector $\eta$ in the binary cube of dimension $n$
$\eta$ belongs to the perpendicular subspace of $H$
